---
title: "Calculations - Wall-Mounted Swing-Jib Crane"
---

The authoritative implementation is [jib-crane-model.js](../../scripts/jib-crane-model.js). It validates all 23 effective inputs and computes both complete signed cases, braced movement and five scoped nominal criteria. All routes use this helper. The [instructor guide](instructor-guide.html) provides its current parameterized solution.

Formal Euler references and the root-fixed P-only comparison are excluded from the braced ranking. Assigned section axes and physical compression resistance remain unvalidated. This page has no separate unfinished numerical implementation.
